new: NFQWS2 Manager has grown into a complete workspace: Master/Config Library/Raw, local lists, NFQWS Menu, Processing Map, Test Lab, Sandbox, Backup Center, System, and guarded Smart Apply/Recovery flows.
The NFQWS UI is reorganized by user task: Configuration, Lists, NFQWS Menu, real Tools, and Maintenance; navigation adapts to narrow screens without horizontal escape.
NFQWS Menu now carries explicit credit for rndnaame/nfqws-menu and uses an exact-ref resolver with GitHub API, Git smart-HTTP fallback, and stale exact-SHA cache.
fixes: NFQWS Manager stale Unix socket cleanup on stop is hardened and hardware-accepted on Keenetic Hopper.
Test Lab layout containment is fixed so inner grids/selects no longer expand outside the panel.
GitHub API 403/429 is no longer treated as automatic upstream failure: rate limiting, stale cache, and real offline states are distinguished.
compatibility: Beta 0.10.0-beta.2 includes routerforge-nfqws-manager in the coherent Beta train for the first time.
Beta is published for aarch64-3.10, mips-3.4, and mipsel-3.4: 7 components × 3 targets = 21 IPKs.
ARM64 remains the production target; MIPS and MIPSel remain experimental. Stable/main is not promoted by this Beta release.
technical: The Beta train uses 0.10.0~beta.2 for all seven components; the immutable snapshot is routerforge-v0.10.0-beta.2.
NFQWS Manager remains an installed-only integration: RouterForge does not automatically install or update the external nfqws2-keenetic package.

The next active workstream is the NFQWS User Experience Roadmap: task-first Home, Import from Zapret, Guided Troubleshooter, Strategy Bench/AutoTune, recommendations + Safe Apply, and consumer hardening.
